create_url_filter: create a URLFilter instance to block domains, URLs, and banned words from document filtering
test_url_filter: test the URLFilter class to verify it blocks documents by domain, subdomain, and banned subwords
run_url_filter: run the URLFilter filter method on a Document to return whether the URL passes filtering
build_url_filter_lists: build URLFilter with custom extra domains, URLs, banned words, and banned subwords for filtering
review_url_filter: review the URLFilter class and its download_data method to load integrated blacklist assets
